I cannot tell you how much we all love Davina. She's a wealth of knowledge and has a solution to all of our puppy problems! Most importantly, Davina is kind, empathetic and gracious in her teaching. She never makes you feel small for not knowing something.
Her methods are always using positive reinforcement, kindness with a no fear approach so your puppy wants to follow what you say, rather than following your commands because it's scared of doing otherwise.

Davina understands puppies and dogs, but she also understands people. We leave her sessions feeling positive and energised because of her own fun, happy go lucky personality.

I cannot recommend Davina's Walkabout Hounds enough. She has it all - superb knowledge, beautiful personality and excellent teaching skills. We're so grateful to know Davina, and my puppy LOVES her.

Initially took my 10 week old puppy to Davina's puppy class, really helpful and clear direction. We then booked some 1-1 sessions which are focusing on lead walking, not reacting and teaching our puppy to be calm. All the strategies are really helping in building foundations with having a well behaved and non reactive dog, cannot thank Davina enough for all her expertise and encouragement.
Absolutely fantastic training sessions from both Davina and James. Niles has come a long way in a short time - highly recommend!
